item.title: 10 killed as bus catches fire after collision with lorry in Karnataka
item.description: BENGALURU: A tragic accident occurred near Gorlathu village, located in the Hiriyur taluk of Chitradurga district, on National Highway 48. A private bus, travelling from Bengaluru to Shivamogga, was involved in a collision with a lorry. The impact caused the bus, a sleeper coach, to catch fire. item.title: Deeply pained by loss of lives in Karnataka bus accident: President Droupadi Murmu
item.description: NEW DELHI: President Droupadi Murmu on Thursday extended her condolences to the families of those killed in a bus accident in Karnataka’s Chitradurga district and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured.
